## Sub-skill routing table

This hub absorbs 7 former standalone skills as on-demand reference files. When a task matches a row, **Read the listed `references/` file** before answering — do not rely on this table alone for depth.

| Sub-topic | When to load | Reference file |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pdf` | PDF expert — create, parse, manipulate, merge, split, watermark, encrypt, sign, validate, and convert PDF files in Python and Node.js. | `references/pdf.md` |
| `docx` | Word document (.docx) expert — create, read, edit, and manipulate .docx files using docx-js (JavaScript) and XML editing. | `references/docx.md` |
| `xlsx` | Excel/spreadsheet expert — create, read, edit, and fix .xlsx files using openpyxl and pandas in Python. | `references/xlsx.md` |
| `pptx` | PowerPoint (.pptx) expert — create, read, edit, and manipulate presentations programmatically using PptxGenJS (Node.js) and python-pptx (Python). | `references/pptx.md` |
| `csv` | CSV/TSV expert — parse, generate, validate, convert, and stream delimited-text files in Python and Node.js. | `references/csv.md` |
| `json-advanced` | Advanced JSON manipulation beyond basic parse/stringify — streaming parsers, JSON Schema | `references/json-advanced.md` |
| `drawio-diagrams` | Programmatic draw.io/diagrams.net (.drawio) file creation, parsing, manipulation, and export. | `references/drawio-diagrams.md` |
